dialogues.speaker: Wuyuan
dialogues.text: Ay yai yai, I've never known a fan to keep up the stupid act for this long!

dialogues.speaker: Wuyuan
dialogues.text: Records of Jueyun is the top-selling, critically acclaimed book series written by yours truly. Even the Wanwen Bookhouse puts them in the most visible location in the store.

dialogues.speaker: Wuyuan
dialogues.text: You'll find all sorts of Liyue myths and legends in this series.
